title: Strategic Initiative Spine: cross-team contribution mappings to company objectives
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Build an interactive 'initiative spine' artifact and operating process that maps every active company-level objective to the set of initiatives and owning teams that contribute measurable progress. Deliverables: (1) a canonical spreadsheet and Confluence page with initiative-to-OKR mappings and RACI, (2) a lightweight dashboard in the Console showing live progress signals (metrics / owner updates / risks), and (3) a rollout plan and workshop materials to socialize across GTM, Eng, Product, and Design.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical initiative-to-OKR map created and signed off by exec sponsors
Dashboard surface with at least 3 live signals (eng throughput, latency SLO trend, GTM adoption) for each objective
Rollout workshop completed with >80% invited stakeholders and a follow-up action list
Operational runbook for quarterly refresh and conflict resolution documented
comments: 2025-01-12 — Kickoff: Workshop with exec sponsors (Lara, Sam) to confirm scope. Agreed to start with top 6 company-level objectives and a 2-week discovery to identify contributing initiatives.

2025-01-20 — Discovery complete: Collected initiative drafts from Eng, Product, GTM; found duplicated ownership for two initiatives spanning Runtime and Console. Assigned follow-up to Eng Leads (ENG-23456) to clarify borders.

2025-01-28 — Decision: Use a single 'spine' matrix format (rows = objectives, columns = initiatives + owner + success signal). Template posted in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INIT-SPINE-2025 — request review by 2025-02-03.

2025-02-03 — PM review: Requested more explicit success signals (quantitative where possible). Design suggested micro-visuals for dashboard to avoid misinterpretation. Action: Sofia to pair with Design (Hana) on dashboard mockups.

2025-02-07 — Engineering feedback: Runtime owners raised that some signals (latency p95) are not yet exposed per initiative; ENG will add metric exports (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/4567). Blocker reduced to medium.

2025-02-11 — Prototype: Dashboard prototype pushed to Console staging (link: https://app.redwood.ai/console/okr-initiative-spine). Contains sample metrics for two objectives. Requested early exec review on 2025-02-14.
2025-02-14 — Exec review notes (Lara): add explicit rollback criteria and tie contribution percentages to initiative budgets. Action: update spine template and add budget column before rollout.
2025-02-14 — Next steps: Finalize template, complete dashboard wiring for remaining objectives, schedule cross-functional rollout workshop week of 2025-02-24. Owner: Sofia Martinez.
